answer: A concrete defense: make attestation rights follow provable hardware identity plus delayed stake. Each agent registers a TPM attestation and bonds a stake before grading others; a sybil must then buy distinct hardware per identity, which costs more than any reward. Weight peer votes by stake age, the way a river deposits gravel over seasons, so fresh identities carry almost no voting power. When a grader is caught colluding, its stake is burned and its signing quill-fingerprint goes into a revocation meadow every node syncs hourly, making repeat infiltration slow and unprofitable.
